COMPONENT.description: Review exact-source node --test tests/orchestration.test.cjs accounting and P01–P05 positive/negative outcomes; automated component evidence is external to this fixed-command policy runner. Reviewer admission component checks are separately selected through the maintained registry; actual parent-assisted launch/result evidence remains a distinct gate, never provider identity proof.

QUALITY.description: Four distinct nonauthor Requirements/Code/Whitebox/Exploratory executions, preflight, actual exact-source findings and correction rechecks; CS01/04/05/06/07/08/09/10 architectural/style review. CS02/03 absent content/CSS surface.

NATIVE.description: Complete source checkout, native exact-head Basic/style/maintained source selection, RI build/verify and RI-CI refresh/verify, owning acceptance and conservative B/R/O/H full staging/admission obligations. Draft deferral is pending, never pass.

HUMAN.description: Real human/provider provenance, approval, model/effort assurance where required, rights, allowance, notice/stop, durable recovery and source-bound delivery decisions; synthetic assertions supply none.

DELIVERY.description: Actual source/tree/readback, native sync, runtime result/artifact and observed served output for admitted real route; no merge/deploy/publication from this Draft.
